name: Default
shortDescription: Single celld node that runs Workers applications with Durable Objects, KV, Queues and D1, storing state in your S3-compatible bucket.

alerts.message: celld needs your own S3-compatible bucket that supports conditional writes. Set CELLD_BUCKET (s3://NAME or s3://NAME/PREFIX), AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, S3_ENDPOINT for a store other than Amazon S3, and AWS_REGION to the bucket's region (default us-east-1), then redeploy. The bucket credentials give full control of the fleet.

The node waits for a deployment and serves nothing until you run `celld deploy . --bucket s3://NAME` from a Wrangler project on your machine, with the same bucket settings. A single node waits for the bucket on every write, so writes are slower than in a multi-node fleet.
